name: B10-0378/2025 (Renew) – Situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the recent wave of terrorist attacks and political violence in Colombia, including the killing of Senator and presidential candidate Miguel Uribe Turbay. It asks Colombia to find and punish those responsible, protect political figures, journalists and human rights defenders, and keep funding the national human rights office. It also warns that violence could grow before the 2026 elections and calls for a safe, peaceful election period. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- No law changes; Parliament urges Colombia to act on security, justice and rights.
- Affects Colombian politicians, journalists, rights defenders and voters before 2026 elections.
- Next: the resolution is sent to European Union bodies and Colombia's government and congress.
